ayahs.1: Ahl-e-kitaab ke kaafir aur mushrik log jab tak ke un ke paas zaahir daleel na aa jaaye baaz rehne wale na the (woh daleel yeh thi ke).
ayahs.2: Allah Taala ka ek Rasool jo paak saheefe padhe.
ayahs.3: Jin mein saheeh aur durust ahkaam hon.
ayahs.4: Ahl-e-kitaab apne paas zaahir daleel aa jaane ke baad hi (ikhtilaaf mein pad kar) mutafarriq ho gaye.
ayahs.5: Unhein is ke siwa koi hukm nahi diya gaya ke sirf Allah ki ibaadat karen, usi ke liye deen ko khaalis rakhen, Ibraheem haneef ke deen par, aur namaz ko qaayam rakhen aur zakaat dete rahen. Yehi hai deen seedhi millat ka.
ayahs.6: Beshak jo log ahl-e-kitaab mein kaafir hue aur mushrikeen, sab dozakh ki aag mein (jaaenge) jahaan woh hamesha (hamesha) rahenge. Yeh log badtareen khalaaiq hain.
ayahs.7: Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye, yeh log behtareen khalaaiq hain.
ayahs.8: Un ka badla un ke Rabb ke paas hameshagi wali jannatein hain jin ke neeche nahrein beh rahi hain, jin mein woh hamesha hamesha rahenge. Allah Taala un se raazi hua aur yeh us se raazi hue. Yeh hai us ke liye jo apne Parwardigaar se dare.
